image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a custom automotive wheel assembly. The wheel features a five-spoke alloy rim with a two-tone finish: polished silver faces on the spokes and a deep metallic red inner barrel and recessed areas. The center cap displays a yellow shield logo with a black prancing horse (resembling the Ferrari emblem). A black rubber tire is mounted on the rim, showing visible tread blocks on the shoulder and white residue/dust on the sidewall. Through the spokes, a drilled brake rotor and caliper are partially visible in the background.
